backupPasswordMessage:
Your password is the master key to your account.

IMPORTANT:
• We do not keep backups of passwords
• Your password is only stored locally on your phone
• If you lose your password, you lose access to your account
• Keep your password safe - write it down or use a password manager
• NEVER share it with anyone
• This is the ONLY way to recover your account

Would you like to copy your password?
passwordCopiedMessage:
Your password has been copied to your clipboard.

Security Tips:
1. Paste it in a secure password manager NOW
2. Clear your clipboard after saving it
3. Never paste it in untrusted apps
4. Remember: We do not keep backups - if you lose it, your account is gone forever
